                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਕੰਟੇਨਰ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = 500 ਲੀਟਰ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਹਰ ਵਾਰ ਕੱਢਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = 45.25 ਲੀਟਰ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਕੱਢਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ = 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਕੱਢਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਕੁੱਲ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੱਢਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ x ਕੱਢਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਬਾਕੀ ਬਚਿਆ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = ਕੰਟੇਨਰ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ - ਕੱਢਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਕੁੱਲ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ਕੱਢਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਕੁੱਲ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = 45.25 x 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ਕੱਢਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਕੁੱਲ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = 135.75 ਲੀਟਰ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ਬਾਕੀ ਬਚਿਆ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = 500 - 135.75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ਬਾਕੀ ਬਚਿਆ ਵੋਲਿਊਮ = 364.25 ਲੀਟਰ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ ਸਹੀ ਜਵਾਬ 364.25 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Expression: [(3/4 + 1/2) ÷ (5/8)] × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. Addition of fractions: a/b + c/d = (ad + bc) / bd

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. Division of fractions: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. Simplification: a × b = product

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ [(3/4 + 1/2) ÷ (5/8)] × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ [(3/4 + 2/4) ÷ (5/8)] × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (5/4) ÷ (5/8) × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (5 × 8) / (4 × 5) × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 2 × (2/3) = 4/3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 4/3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      व्यंजक: [(3/4 + 1/2) ÷ (5/8)] × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. भिन्नों का योग: a/b + c/d = (ad + bc) / bd

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. भिन्नों का विभाजन: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. सरलीकरण: a × b = गुणनफल

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ [(3/4 + 1/2) ÷ (5/8)] × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ [(3/4 + 2/4) ÷ (5/8)] × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (5/4) ÷ (5/8) × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (5 × 8) / (4 × 5) × (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 2 × (2/3) = 4/3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 4/3 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Capital ratio of X and Y = 5 : 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Profit ratio of X and Y = 5 : 4ఇవ్వబడినది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      సమీకరణం: [(3/4 + 1/2) ÷ (5/8)] x (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. భిన్నాల సంకలనం: a/b + c/d = (ad + bc) / bd

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. భిన్నాల భాగాహారం: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) x (d/c)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. సరళీకరణ: a x b = లబ్ధం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ [(3/4 + 1/2) ÷ (5/8)] x (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ [(3/4 + 2/4) ÷ (5/8)] x (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (5/4) ÷ (5/8) x (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (5 x 8) / (4 x 5) x (2/3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 2 x (2/3) = 4/3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ సరైన సమాధానం 4/3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (5.4 + 2.6) ÷ 0.5 + (2.5 x 3/5)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 8 ÷ 0.5 + 1.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 16 + 1.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 17.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ சரியான பதில் 17.5 ஆகும்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Capital ratio of X and Y = 5 : 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Profit ratio of X and Y = 5 : 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Investment period for X = 12 months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Capital × Time = Profit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Profit ratio = (CapitalX × TimeX) : (CapitalY × TimeY)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (5 × 12) : (8 × TimeY) = 5 : 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (60) : (8 × TimeY) = 5 : 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 60 / (8 × TimeY) = 5 / 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 4 × 60 = 5 × (8 × TimeY)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 240 = 40 × TimeY

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ TimeY = 240 / 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ TimeY = 6 months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 6 months.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n", "hn": "
