                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 2: To enjoy success (सफलता का आनंद लेना) – Incorrect, because the idiom is about admitting mistakes, not celebrating success.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: He enjoyed success after years of hard work.

The idiom emphasizes admitting mistakes, not just accepting defeat.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The team accepted defeat modestly after the final match.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 4: To face punishment (सज़ा का सामना करना) – Incorrect, because the idiom is about self-admission of error, not external punishment.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The criminal faced punishment for his actions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is: Rational.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word \"Zany\" refers to someone or something that is amusingly unconventional or eccentric. It implies behavior or characteristics that are quirky, strange, or comical. (अनोखा या हास्यास्पद)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The zany clown entertained the children with his silly antics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \"Rational\" means logical or reasonable, and it is the antonym of \"Zany\". Rational behavior is sensible and well-thought-out, in contrast to eccentric or whimsical behavior. (तार्किक)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: She made a rational decision after carefully analyzing the situation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'Zany' is 'Rational'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is: Rational.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The comical expressions of the actor made the audience laugh uncontrollably.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Whimsical (खुशनुमा या अजीब): Playfully quaint or fanciful, especially in an appealing and amusing way.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The whimsical artwork in the gallery caught everyone’s attention.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word \"Amnesty\" refers to a general pardon granted by the government, especially for political offenses. (सामूहिक माफी)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The government declared an amnesty for all political prisoners to promote peace and unity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \"Pardon\" refers to the official forgiveness of a crime by an authority, often used in the context of individuals.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The president issued a pardon to the convicted prisoner.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Hence, we can conclude that \"amnesty\" is the correct one-word substitution for a general pardon granted by the government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is: Amnesty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Pardon (क्षमादान): Forgiveness for an offense or fault, often granted to individuals.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The king issued a pardon to the soldier for his disobedience.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Clemency (दयालुता): Mercy or lenience shown towards someone who could be punished harshly.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The judge showed clemency by reducing the prison sentence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Reprieve (स्थगन): A temporary delay or cancellation of a punishment, especially a death sentence.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word \"Cipher\" refers to a secret or coded form of writing, often used for secure communication.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The archaeologists discovered an ancient scroll with historical records.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The topic was sensitive, so he decided to ____ it", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Put off"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Go into"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Back out of"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Brush through"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The phrasal verb \"Back out of\" means to withdraw from something, especially a commitment or agreement. (पीछे हट जाना)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: He backed out of the deal at the last minute, leaving everyone surprised.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \"Brush through\" is not a correct phrasal verb in this context and doesn't apply to the given statement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, \"Back out of\" is the correct phrasal verb to use in the given sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Put off (टालना): To delay or postpone something.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: We had to put off the meeting due to unforeseen circumstances.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Go into (जाना या चर्चा करना): To discuss or examine something in detail.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: We need to go into the details of the project before making a decision.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Brush through (तेजी से गुजरना): To pass over something quickly or without much attention.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She brushed through the documents without reading them carefully.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n1d0:T8d7,\n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is ' The manuscript was valued not only for its age but also for the ____ of its preservation", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Accuracy"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Delicacy"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Thoroughness"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Speed"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 'Thoroughness'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
